findings.Quote: You didn't aim at a neuretic call. You aimed at things you could hurt.
findings.Note: The purpose specifies she draws Problem Solver and he is unthreatened because threatening a projection is threatening a phone call — but the prose has her reasoning her way out of the draw herself, undercutting the beat's point (his indifference to the threat) rather than showing it land on him.
findings.Fix: Show her drawing and holding on him, and have his non-reaction (or a line acknowledging the futility) land the point, rather than her pre-empting it with internal logic.

findings.Quote: She catalogs it. She does not react.
